title: neobartlettia ehrenbergii
intro: Neobartlettia ehrenbergii, commonly known as 'Golden Thread', is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Neobartlettia ehrenbergii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
